logistics-ai.name: Transportation and logistics
logistics-ai.headline: Keep Every Shipment Conversation Moving
logistics-ai.summary: Capture shipping quote requests, pickup details, customer and carrier information, callback needs, and routing context around the clock.
problems: Quote requests arrive while sales teams are handling active shipments.
Callers repeat origin, destination, equipment, and timing details after transfers.
After-hours inquiries can wait until the next business day.
Customer and carrier conversations are difficult to attribute across systems.

scenarios.title: Shipping quote
scenarios.transcript: Caller provides Miami origin, Dallas destination, pallet count, weight, and pickup date.
scenarios.outcome: Qualified quote request prepared for the sales queue.

scenarios.title: Pickup scheduling
scenarios.transcript: Customer confirms account, location, freight type, dock hours, and preferred pickup window.
scenarios.outcome: Pickup request prepared for dispatch review.

scenarios.title: After-hours callback
scenarios.transcript: Carrier requests a callback about an urgent next-day load.
scenarios.outcome: Urgency and callback context queued for a human operator.

faq: Can Codestra replace our current telephone number?
The approved implementation can normally use forwarding or provider routing so the existing public number remains unchanged.
Can it create freight quotes automatically?
It can collect and validate required inputs. Final pricing and quote release remain within approved business rules and human controls.
Can calls route by terminal or office?
Yes. Routing can use location, department, language, caller type, operating hours, intent, and urgency.
Does it connect to Odoo?
The controlled middleware supports Odoo lead delivery. Each field, campaign, team, and owner mapping is confirmed in staging before live writes.
Is the demonstration real activity?
No. All demonstrations and figures on this page are clearly labeled simulations or sample data.
qualifyingQuestions: Shipper, carrier, broker, or logistics provider
